style: premium collectible Roblox-inspired 3D game render, cinematic horror lighting, deep graphite shadows, electric-blue/cyan edge light, restrained red danger light from the environment, no text in image
negative: starter avatar, changed hair or crown, colored hoodie, missing backpack, different lantern, realistic human proportions, extra fingers, brand logos, embedded text, gore, fake game UI

character.note: Approve the turnaround from prompts/image-generation.md first

corridor.note: One location plate reused for every corridor shot

style.note: One approved frame that sets light and color

continuity: Same ingredients in every generated shot: character + location + style (Veo accepts up to 3 reference images).
Continuous action: scene N starts from the last frame of scene N-1 (first/last-frame or scene extension). New location = hard cut, no chaining.
Screen direction: if the subject exits right, it enters the next shot from the left (180° rule).
Cut on movement and continue that movement in the next shot (match on action).
One camera move per shot. Don’t reverse the previous move unless it’s a reveal.
Keep key-light direction and palette between consecutive shots; only the environment turns red for danger.
Keep subject speed the same across a cut; change speed only on a story beat.

avatar.label: Roblox avatar
avatar.lock: block proportions, face, hair with three tufts, silver-blue crown, black techwear jacket, backpack with cyan core, cargo pants, sneakers, cyan lantern
avatar.motion: blocky limb swing, weight on chunky feet, no realistic anatomy or cloth stretch

human.label: Human
human.lock: face, hair, wardrobe, body type, accessories
human.motion: natural gait, consistent walking speed, hands stay anatomically plausible

vehicle.label: Vehicle
vehicle.lock: body shape, color, wheels, livery, damage
vehicle.vary: angle, lighting, road, speed only on a beat
vehicle.motion: wheels rotate with direction of travel, camera tracks parallel, never flip direction between cuts

landscape.label: Landscape
landscape.lock: time of day, weather, horizon height, landmark positions
landscape.motion: slow push, pan or drone with parallax; no sudden weather change

building.label: Building / interior
building.lock: layout (doors, windows, stairs), materials, light fixtures
building.vary: camera path, which room is lit
building.motion: dolly or steady walk that respects geometry; doors stay where they were

product.label: Product / object
product.motion: macro slide or slow orbit; no label morphing

scenes.visual: Real moment of tension: enemy right outside the hiding spot. Start mid-action.
scenes.narration: Is this hiding spot still safe after the monster leaves?
scenes.edit: No intro, no logo. Game audio up.

scenes.visual: Game name/version, the spot, and what counts as success.
scenes.narration: State the game, version, and success rule.
scenes.edit: Name card over footage, under 2 seconds.

scenes.visual: Minimally edited evidence: full departure, then the wait.
scenes.narration: It’s leaving. Now we wait.
scenes.edit: Keep game audio; duck music.

scenes.visual: Replay the relevant moment, slowed, one callout. Don’t change its meaning.
scenes.narration: Here’s the moment that decides it.
scenes.edit: Freeze-frame and one callout.

scenes.visual: Verdict card over the last frame.
scenes.narration: Confirmed, busted or inconclusive, plus a one-sentence reason.
scenes.edit: Hold 2 seconds; loop back to the hook frame.
